  • No oils, liquids, paints, or combustibles are allowed in the container. Tires are also prohibited. If tires are found at the landfill during disposal, a $50 per tire fee will be charged to the customer.
  • The container must be filled to water level — no materials should exceed the rim or hang over the sides. There is a 5-ton weight limit; any excess weight will incur additional charges based on the landfill’s rate per ton.
  • For safety and compliance with DOT regulations, containers cannot exceed 10 tons.
  • Before transporting the container, the door must be securely shut, locked, latched, and pinned to ensure safe hauling.
  • New Container Setup: A 24–48-hour notice is required to determine availability.
  • An additional $150 Drop and Hook fee if the container needs to be placed back in the exact same spot when returning to site.
  • An Additional $150 fee if a liner is required.
  • New customer: Prior to setup and billing, a credit application must be completed and approved.
  • Reroofing Dump Fee (Shingles): An additional $200 per dump will apply if the dumpster is used for reroofing and contains a majority of shingles.
